_doc: AC08 (Контейнер НКУ) VPM texture sets, KPP1 recipe. Gate 1 approved by Artem 2026-10-22 (#565 «Принимаю»): ID2 sandwich panels RAL 5015, ID3 door RAL 7004; ID1 = frame band + roof, Gate-1 RAL 7004 superseded by Artem 2026-10-22 on v008 (panels accepted; the outer wall / frame band is BLUE RAL 5015 with the sheet's thin dark outline, RAL 7004 only for doors, porches/steps, the plinth and parts the sheet shows grey). Rework 2026-10-22 (PR #574 issuecomment-6342141336, supersedes the 0.60 m step): joint COUNT per facade from the colour-solution sheet (facades, facades_doc) [D169]; Artem's texture panel_RAL5015_vertical_joints_4096.png (SHA256 checked) gives the colour, noise and the look of one 8 mm joint only, repeated at P = field / ribs; KPP VPM texel 1000 px/m (density twin KPP Cassette_RAL5015, S = 4.096 m); two tiles because the long and short facades have different pitches; faces longer than S - 2 pad - P are cut by edge rings at joints (finish_map.apply_cuts). Below ±0.000 = plain plinth RAL 7004 (sheet grey). Placeholders 256 px single colour (reg p.31 §3). Address Nku_1 is a placeholder token.

facades_doc: Rib contract (Artem 2026-10-22, operator measurements: long 1-2 = 30 ribs, short A-B/B-A = 12, ~0.20 m, evenly over the whole panel field, symmetric, no horizontal joints). Source: the building's own colour-solution sheet 22Е56-АР2-1002-АС.08.dwg (AutoCAD readback C:/x/tec26-oks/acad-readback-v001/ac08.dxf, read by scripts/sheet_facades.py -> AC08/sheet-facades.json): the field inside the 100 mm posts / 150 mm rails is 5858 mm (long) / 2238 mm (short) with 29 / 11 vertical joint lines drawn every 200 mm from the field's left edge (58 / 38 mm remainder at the right) -> ribs = joints + 1 = 30 / 12. Model field (ID2 panels of max-dump-008) = 5.8595 / 2.2353 m; P = field_m / ribs = 0.19532 / 0.18628 m, joints at field_lo + k P (k = 1 .. ribs - 1), so the sheet's uneven last strip becomes the operator's even symmetric layout. Facade names: south -y = 2-1 (door, axis 2 at -x), north +y = 1-2, west -x = A-B, east +x = B-A (porch side, sheet elevations).
